# Class SessionRequest

[java.lang.Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class or interface in java.lang")

com.google.adk.web.dto.SessionRequest

* * *

public final class SessionRequest extends [Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class or interface in java.lang")

Data Transfer Object (DTO) for POST /apps/{appName}/users/{userId}/sessions and POST /apps/{appName}/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId} equests. Contains information for a session.
